title: Paxie Hex Fall Level (external format)
description: JSON Schema for level files in the Paxie editor format. Derived empirically from the 100-level dataset survey (see CLASSIFIED.paxie_data/survey_report.md). This is the format produced by Anıl's level editor; the simulator's native format is described in level_schema.json. Fields marked optional are present in only a subset of surveyed levels; the survey's coverage percentages are noted inline where relevant.

levelNumber.description: 1-based level index. Observed range 1–100 in the dataset; no upper bound enforced here.

levelVersionCode.description: Editor-side format version. All 100 surveyed levels carry value 1; future exports may bump this.

collectorArea.description: The collector grid (target area) plus all of its mechanic-specific overlays. Each mechanic occupies its own array; the cells are not unified under a single 'cells' list.

singleBlockCollectors.description: Plain colored collector cells. Present in 100/100 levels.

iceCollectors.description: Ice-encased collector cells; revealed colour and capacity-to-thaw. Non-empty in 38/100 surveyed levels (first appearance at level 39).

pinBlockers.description: Directional pin obstacles. Non-empty in 22/100 surveyed levels (first appearance at level 64).

mysteryCollectors.description: Reserved mechanic — present as an empty array in 92/100 surveyed levels but never populated. Item schema unknown from the dataset; accept any objects.

woodBoxCollectors.description: Question-bucket equivalents: a collector cell whose colour is hidden until revealed. Non-empty in 50/100 surveyed levels.

tunnels.description: Generator-equivalent tunnels: emit a queued sequence of coloured blocks in a fixed direction. Non-empty in 56/100 surveyed levels.

deadCells.description: Wall / blocked cells in the collector grid. Non-empty in 97/100 surveyed levels.

keyLocks.description: Key-lock pairs (a key at one location unlocks a gate at another). Non-empty in only 1/100 surveyed levels (level 100); appears to be a late-game mechanic.

tiedPairs.description: Reserved mechanic — present as either null or an empty array in 21/100 surveyed levels; never populated. Item schema unknown.

hexStackArea.description: The hex-field where stacks of coloured slices live; the source area the player drains into collectorArea.

gridHeight.description: Observed range 8–33; the field can scroll vertically.

stacks.description: Non-empty stacks placed in the hex field.

tunnels.description: Always present as an empty array in 89/100 surveyed levels; never observed populated. Treat as vestigial unless future levels populate it. If non-empty, expected to follow the same shape as collectorArea.tunnels.

editorMeta.description: Editor-side parameters and generation knobs. Some fields are universal; others appear only in subsets of levels.

totalBlocks.description: Total slice count across the hex field. Observed range 144–1272.

colorCount.description: Number of distinct colours declared by the editor. Observed range 2–6. Note: 2 surveyed levels (87, 91) have actual distinct colours exceeding this declared value — loaders should warn rather than reject.

maxColorsPerStack.description: Editor knob: ceiling on distinct colours per stack. Observed values 1 or 2.

heightMin.description: Minimum stack height the generator was configured to produce. Observed 3–9.

heightMax.description: Maximum stack height the generator was configured to produce. Observed 3–9.

verticalPercent.description: Vertical-pattern emphasis as a percentage. Observed 0.0–100.0 (median 0).

horizontalPercent.description: Horizontal-pattern emphasis as a percentage. Observed 0.0–44.0 (median 0).

mysteryPercent.description: Mystery-collector ratio. Always 0.0 in the surveyed dataset; matches the always-empty mysteryCollectors array.

clusteringEnabled.description: Whether the editor's clustering pass was enabled during generation. Present in 89/100 levels.

clusteringPercent.description: Strength of the clustering pass when enabled. Present in 89/100 levels; observed 0.0–100.0.

colorsPerStackRatios.description: Ratio knobs for how many distinct colours per stack (each entry corresponds to a colour-count bucket). Present in 68/100 levels; all observed lists have length 1; values 0.0–100.0.

zoneCount.description: Number of zones (palette partitions) the generator was configured with. Present in 57/100 levels; observed 1–5.

zoneColors.description: Per-zone palette assignment, ordered by zone index. Present in 10/100 levels — always as list_of_lists (each inner list is the palette for that zone). Observed: 3–5 zones, 2–6 colours per zone.

color_token.description: A colour code. Two encodings coexist in the dataset: short codes (e.g. 'y', 'w', 'r', 'dg', 'db', 'pk', 'dgr') and full-name aliases (e.g. 'Yellow', 'DarkRed', 'OliveGreen'). The full-name variant appears only inside tunnel queues and looks like a partially-migrated legacy encoding — translators SHOULD canonicalise to short codes. 23 short codes and 9 full-name aliases observed.

direction.description: Capitalised direction string used by tunnels and pinBlockers.

grid_pos.description: Integer (x, y) position inside whichever grid the parent belongs to.

iceCapacity.description: Number of matching deliveries needed to break the ice. Observed range 3–22 (mean ~10).

hiddenColor.description: The colour underneath the ice; revealed once the ice is broken.

blockCount.description: Optional. Observed in 9 of the surveyed pin blockers; values 0–3. Many pinBlocker entries omit this field entirely.

hiddenColor.description: The colour inside the wood box; the editor analogue of a 'question bucket'.

ca_tunnel.description: Generator-style tunnel: at position (x, y) facing `direction`, producing the queued sequence of coloured blocks. The same shape is reused for hexStackArea.tunnels (which is always empty in this dataset).

collectorQueue.description: Ordered queue of coloured blocks to emit. Index 0 = next emitted. Observed lengths 2–7 (median 4).

key_lock.description: Key + lock pair. Picking up the key at (keyX, keyY) unlocks the gate at (lockX, lockY). Only observed in level 100 of the surveyed dataset.

stack.description: A vertical stack of coloured slices placed at (x, y) on the hexStackArea grid.

colors.description: Slice colours, ordered from one end of the stack to the other. Observed stack heights 3–9 (mean ~6).
